description: projects of noise level on railway lines is a data set deposited in MOST Wiedzy by its authors Roksana Licow. Projects of acoustic signals from railway lines for further analysis in the BK Connect software. The data was collected as part of scientific activity number 2022/06/X/ST8/00402. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
